fetched_sources.title: Run prompts on a schedule
key_claims: three scheduling options compared: Cloud routines / Desktop scheduled tasks / /loop
/loop is a bundled prompt-based skill; interval+prompt fixed cron, prompt-only self-paced (1min-1h), interval-only or bare uses built-in maintenance prompt or loop.md
seconds rounded up to minute; 7m/90m rounded to nearest clean cron step and reported
loop.md at .claude/loop.md (project precedence) or ~/.claude/loop.md; truncated beyond 25000 bytes; edits take effect next iteration

stop self-paced loop with Esc (clears pending wakeup) or ScheduleWakeup stop:true; if an iteration neither reschedules nor stops, one fallback wakeup ~20 min later; fixed-interval loops run until cancelled or 7 days
scheduler checks every second and enqueues at low priority; a scheduled prompt fires between turns, waits until the current turn ends if Claude is busy
no catch-up for missed fires: fires once when idle, not once per missed interval
jitter: recurring up to 30 min late (or half the interval for sub-hourly); one-shot on the hour/half-hour up to 90 s early; offset derived from task ID
recurring tasks auto-expire 7 days after creation; they fire one final time then delete themselves
all times interpreted in local timezone
cron: standard 5-field, wildcards/steps/ranges/lists; no L/W/?/MON/JAN; DOM+DOW constrained uses vixie-cron OR semantics
CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON=1 disables the scheduler entirely
session-scoped; --resume/--continue restores unexpired CronCreate tasks except expired recurring and past one-shot; self-paced /loop is NOT restored; background Bash and monitor tasks never restored

durable path stores task in project .claude/scheduled_tasks.json; symlinked .claude or that file returns an error; saved task runs only in the project folder where created, listing elsewhere but not running
8-character task ID; max 50 scheduled tasks per session
tools: CronCreate, CronList, CronDelete

placement_recheck.claim: Documented runtime idle/busy does not establish a conversation-level chat_active detector. Our lab treats these as separate explicit inputs.

fetched_sources.title: Push events into a running session with channels
key_claims: channel = an MCP server that pushes events into a running session; can be two-way (Claude replies back through the same channel)
events arrive only while the session is open; run CC in a background process or persistent terminal for always-on
research preview; needs claude.ai or Console API key auth; unavailable on Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry; Team/Enterprise must enable
--channels and --dangerously-load-development-channels do not appear in claude --help during preview but work
install as plugin (telegram/discord/imessage/fakechat@claude-plugins-official); creds saved to ~/.claude/channels/<name>/.env; channel plugins require Bun
terminal shows an inbound channel line; the model receives a <channel source="plugin:..."> event using the scoped server name
terminal shows the tool call and a confirmation (e.g. 'sent'); the actual reply appears on the other platform, not in the terminal
permission prompt while away pauses the session; channel servers declaring the permission relay capability can forward prompts for remote approve/deny
each approved channel plugin maintains a sender allowlist; others are silently dropped
being in .mcp.json is not enough; a server must also be named in --channels
the allowlist also gates permission relay: anyone who can reply through the channel can approve or deny tool use

channelsEnabled master switch; allowedChannelPlugins replaces the Anthropic allowlist; empty array blocks allowlist plugins but --dangerously-load-development-channels can still bypass for local testing; leave channelsEnabled unset to block channels entirely including the dev flag

claude.ai Team/Enterprise blocked until Owner enables; Console API key allowed by default unless the organization deploys managed settings (then explicit enablement required); Pro/Max without an org skip these checks
a plugin not on the allowlist starts normally but the channel does not register, with a startup notice
on the v2 MCP client runtime, a channel server negotiating protocol revision 2026-07-28 does not register

fetched_sources.title: Heartbeat
key_claims: heartbeat is a system-owned automation running periodic agent turns in the main session

cadence owned by the Automations scheduler; one system-owned automation job per heartbeat-enabled agent, visible in 'openclaw cron list --all' as 'Heartbeat (agent-id)'; config is desired-state input, persisted monitor schedule owns the tick and runner cooldown
default interval 30m, 1h when Anthropic OAuth/token auth resolved, only while heartbeat.every unset; 0m disables recurring cadence
scheduled heartbeats require automations; cron.enabled=false or OPENCLAW_SKIP_CRON=1 logs a startup warning and skips scheduled heartbeats; no separate heartbeat fallback timer
targeted event wakes remain; rate limits 30-second minimum between event turns and a flood guard after five starts within 60 seconds
default prompt sent verbatim as the scheduled user message; no heartbeat-specific system-prompt section

scheduled heartbeats defer while main queue/automation work is active or queued, any reply/embedded run for the same agent is active, or the target session has active or queued work; an event-free plain monitor poll not yet preparing is recorded as skipped and waits for the next persisted cadence tick; wakes carrying queued events/scheduled tasks still retry; sibling agents do not pause each other
'Jobs due together can coalesce into one heartbeat turn.'

response contract: reply NO_REPLY when nothing needs attention; heartbeat_respond notify:false (silent) or notify:true + notificationText (alert); structured tool response takes precedence over text fallback
a meaningful notify:false result is remembered as bounded internal context for the next user turn; no_change acknowledgments and confirmed visible notifications are not stored that way
legacy HEARTBEAT_OK accepted at start or end of a reply, dropped when remaining content <=300 chars; not special in the middle
visibility flags showOk/showAlerts/useIndicator (per-account -> per-channel -> defaults); if all three false the run is skipped up front (no model call), reason=alerts-disabled
heartbeat-only replies do not keep the session alive; idle expiry uses lastInteractionAt, daily expiry uses sessionStartedAt

if a channel readiness check blocks an alert, non-delivery is recorded and the heartbeat retries after a one-minute grace period without consuming its cadence slot; the retry re-runs the heartbeat, it does not replay the exact alert; once a send enters the durable delivery queue that queue owns transport retries
empty scratch (only blank lines, comments, headings, fence markers, empty checklist stubs) skips the run, reason=empty-heartbeat-file
isolatedSession:true runs each heartbeat in a fresh session with no prior conversation history; lightContext:true skips workspace bootstrap files; monitor scratch injected either way
heartbeat target: owner (default, operator DM, never a group), last, an explicit channel, or none; without a resolvable owner DM ambient polls skip reason=no-route
migration: openclaw doctor --fix creates/updates monitor rows from agents.*.heartbeat and imports workspace HEARTBEAT.md into monitor scratch; runtime reads database scratch only
not_written_because_not_stated: exact retry/backoff internals beyond the one-minute grace and durable queue ownership
response shapes of any tool beyond heartbeat_respond's notify/notificationText/scratch

fetched_sources.title: Automations
key_claims: automations are OpenClaw's built-in scheduler; it persists jobs, wakes the agent at the right time, and can deliver output to a chat channel, a webhook, or nowhere
manage with 'openclaw automations'; 'openclaw cron' remains an alias
supports one-shot reminders, recurring intervals and cron expressions, and inbound webhook triggers
CLI: automations create/get/show/list/runs; quickstart one-shot reminder with --session main --system-event --wake now --delete-after-run
this page is an index: run lifecycle, schedules, payloads, delivery, managing-jobs, webhooks, gmail are child pages

fetched_sources.title: Automation
key_claims: decision table: automations vs heartbeat monitor automation
automations: one-shot/interval/cron; isolated/current/named/main session; channel/webhook/silent; explicit reports/reminders/recurring work
heartbeat: scheduler-owned interval default 30min; main session (optionally isolated); owner-routed alerts or silent; ambient monitoring and event follow-up
both use the same Automations scheduler

empty scratch skips as empty-heartbeat-file; scheduled monitor turns defer while the main queue or automation work is busy, another run for the same agent is active, or the target session has active or queued work
inferred commitments removed in v2026.8.1; the openclaw commitments CLI is gone; create an explicit automation instead
